patches.new:
if status_raw_filters or include_unknown_status:
        status_parts = []
        if status_raw_filters:
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in status_raw_filters)
            status_parts.append(f"json_extract(ic.raw, '$.claimState') IN ({placeholders})")
            params.extend(status_raw_filters)
        if include_unknown_status:
            known_states = list(_CS_STATUS_MAP)
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in known_states)
            status_parts.append(
                "(json_extract(ic.raw, '$.claimState') IS NULL OR "
                f"json_extract(ic.raw, '$.claimState') NOT IN ({placeholders}))"
            )
            params.extend(known_states)
        where_parts.append("(" + " OR ".join(status_parts) + ")")
